name.ja: 1/35 U.C.HARD GRAPH 地球連邦軍 対MS特技兵セット
name.en: 1/35 U.C.HARD GRAPH Earth Federation Army Anti-MS Specialized Soldier Set

ja: 機動戦士ガンダムの世界を写実的に再現した「U.C.ハードグラフ」に新ラインナップ“地球連邦軍 対MS特技兵セット”が登場。兵士のマルチカラードフィギュアは服装から表情に至るまで1/1をリアルに感じさせるこだわりのディテールを表現。兵士と同スケールで再現された陸戦型ガンダムの腕は、各部関節や骨格と装甲板の構造まで細密に再現。
en: A new lineup "Earth Federation Army Anti-MS Specialized Soldier Set " is now available in " U.C. Hard Graph", which realistically reproduces the world of Mobile Suit Gundam. The soldier's multi-colored figure expresses meticulous details that make it feel 1/1 realistic, from clothing to facial expressions. The arm of the ground combat type Gundam, which has been reproduced in the same scale as the soldier, has been reproduced in detail, including the joints, skeleton, and armor plate structure.
